title: Algerian Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy Algerian-inspired dish featuring marinated chicken kebabs grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of couscous and vegetables for a complete meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Algerian spice blend, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the kebab skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Serve the kebabs hot with a side of couscous and vegetables.
